articles.title: Crypto campaign fund Fairshake faces $2 million setback in Florida primaries
articles.snippet: In a race that drew criticism to crypto's leading political action committee for featuring fake headlines in ads, Fairshake's expensive effort fell short.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Where DeFi yield really comes from (and why it broke this spring)
articles.snippet: In this week's Crypto Long & Short, Solstice Finance's David Plisek argues that most of the money lost in DeFi this spring wasn't taken by hackers but by yield strategies that quietly stopped working. Looking at April's $13 billion drawdown, he shows that a headline yield number reveals almost nothing about whether it will hold under stress, laying out four questions an allocator should ask before committing capital.

articles.title: MiCA cracks down on USDT in Europe... but no one else cares
articles.snippet: USDT is disappearing from regulated European platforms, but there is little sign that it has resulted in weakening global demand for Tether.

articles.title: Cybersecurity firm unveils crypto phishing campaign targeting 885,000 phone numbers
articles.snippet: Rapid7 unveiled a new cryptocurrency phishing campaign targeting 885,000 phone numbers, aiming to steal investors’ holdings by redirecting them to fake wallet provider websites.

articles.title: Crypto PAC notches primary wins, but loses $2M Florida race
articles.snippet: A Fairshake spokesperson said that the PAC was “just getting started“ on its expenditures as part of efforts to fill US Congress with lawmakers friendly to the crypto industry.
